query: SELECT COALESCE(from_game, '(unbekannt)') AS "from_game!", COALESCE(to_game, '(unbekannt)') AS "to_game!", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "cnt!", COALESCE(AVG(viewer_count), 0)::float8 AS "avg_v!" FROM exp_game_transitions WHERE LOWER(streamer) = $1 AND ts_utc >= $2 GROUP BY from_game, to_game ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 50
